Two Ni-based single crystal superalloys with varying Ru contents were used, and their nominal chemical compositions are provided in Table 1. They differed only in the Ru content, thus denoted as "0Ru" and "3Ru" hereafter.
The alloys were fabricated through directional solidification investment casting. The single crystal rods had dimensions of Φ 16 mm × 160 mm along [001] axial orientation.
Subsequently, the rod ingot underwent electric spark-cutting to produce cylindrical samples with dimensions of Φ 16 mm × 5 mm.
The solution heat treatment procedure involved 1345 ◦C/4 h + 1120 ◦C/4 h + 870 ◦C/32 h (air cooling, AC).
The alloys were fabricated through directional solidification investment casting.

conflicts.description: Some studies report that Ru may promote TCP precipitation; Chen et al. observed TCP volume fractions of 3.1% and 6.3% in 0 wt.% Ru and 5 wt.% Ru alloys after thermal exposure 800 h at 1100 °C.
